profile.belief: Bootleg movies! I didn’t grow up with a lot so it was always about cutting corners. My mom would buy me bootlegs from the hair salon and eventually I figured out how to pirate movies online. As I got older I started building my own dvd collection to make up for it lol. A lot of my life I was always focused on looking for ways to make the people around me smile. So I was always performing monologues for my family and I sort of bled into other fields like improv, stand up, music, and screenwriting. I was always a writer even before movies so it felt natural to me to lean into screenwriting for college.
profile.working_on: I want to be a show runner and producer. When I’m not working on my own projects I’m helping produce my friend’s projects.
